name: ECHO-wide Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (event history)
directions: For each item, answer about events before age 18. This ECHO-wide form records event history and is not the scored Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ). Follow the skip instructions on the source form.
interpretationNote: Descriptive event history; no total score or diagnosis is produced.
attribution: ECHO-wide Cohort Version 01.20, Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (Form CTQ). Pennebaker & Susman (1988).
